title: Min Stack
hints: Scanning the stack for the minimum makes get_min O(n). The minimum only changes when the stack changes, and a pop restores whatever the minimum was before the matching push. What could you remember at push time?
Store, next to each value, the minimum of the stack at the moment that value was pushed. Popping then restores the earlier minimum for free.

Either push (value, current_min) pairs onto one list, or keep a second 'min stack' that only receives a value when it is <= the current minimum (and pops when the popped value equals its top). Use <=, not <, so duplicates of the minimum work.
